title: CI skeleton: lint, typecheck, unit, probe-immutability
description: Add ci.yml with install, lint, typecheck, unit tests and a job that fails if probes/ or Tier 0 paths changed in a PR without a human approval label.
acceptance: A PR with a type error fails CI
A PR that edits a file under probes/ from an agent identity fails CI
CI runtime on an empty change is under 4 minutes
